documents.title: White County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 188 pages. Amounts are the Ordinance Section 5 amounts (the only appropriation column) for funds and departments; the detail pages' TOTAL <category> rows for categories column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.

documents.title: White County 2026 budget (as reported)
documents.note: Figures as reported in local news of the Quorum Court’s 2026 budget adoption. The full ordinance is public record; the artransparency.gov copy blocks automated access, so line-item ingestion awaits a direct pull.
